name: shahnaz-kitchen
description: Cloud kitchen website for Shahnaz Kitchen (MERN + Tailwind)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:memory --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:mongo: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
